name: Tower of Gold
summary:
Explore a sprawling dark fantasy world of puzzles, action and mystery on your quest to calm the lingering spirits of a recent war. Search for spells and artifacts in a first-person overworld, gather clues from the townsfolk, and descend into deadly labyrinths where the unknown awaits.

Tower of Gold is a very large and challenging game, but features separate difficulty settings for puzzles, combat, and overworld guidance. As it contains some mild horror elements, there is also a setting to reduce potentially frightening or unsettling content.
